notes:
# Logistic regression gradient (my notes)

Model: z = w^T x + b,  y_hat = sigma(z) = 1 / (1 + e^{-z})
Loss for one example (binary cross entropy):
  L = -[ y log(y_hat) + (1 - y) log(1 - y_hat) ]

Want: dL/dw

Chain: dL/dw = dL/dy_hat * dy_hat/dz * dz/dw

- dL/dy_hat = -y/y_hat + (1-y)/(1-y_hat)
- dy_hat/dz = sigma(z)(1 - sigma(z)) = y_hat (1 - y_hat)    <- sigmoid derivative
- dz/dw = x

Multiply first two: the y_hat(1-y_hat) cancels the denominators ->  dL/dz = y_hat - y   (!!)
So dL/dw = (y_hat - y) x      same form as linear regression w/ squared error
and dL/db = y_hat - y
